title: crm — CRM pipeline/lead/opportunity/stage deep L3
key_finding: CRM leads have zero accounting effect; expected_revenue is a pipeline forecast field only. The won/lost state machine is driven by stage.is_won + probability + active flags. Lead-to-opportunity conversion (type change + date_conversion) is separate from any sale.order creation. PLS (Naive Bayes) drives automated_probability but user can override. Personal lead record rule restricts salesperson visibility to own or unassigned leads.
gap_addressed: no existing L3 evidence for CRM pipeline/lead/opportunity/stage
cross_module_links: sale_crm: opportunity_id on sale.order, revenue sync on confirm
calendar: calendar_event_ids on crm.lead via opportunity_id
